About Us

Gold Horizon Corporation — Fatah Garh, Sialkot

Gold Horizon Corporation is a manufacturer & exporter based in Fatah Garh, Sialkot, Pakistan — the city recognised around the world for its surgical-instrument craftsmanship. The company supplies five connected product lines: surgical instruments, dental instruments, beauty instruments, equestrian products, and farrier tools & instruments.

For buyers, that means one direct contact for a wide instrument range — no directory middlemen, no commission platforms in between. Send your requirement on WhatsApp and deal directly with the exporter.

  • ✓One source, five lines — surgical, dental, beauty, equestrian & farrier from a single Sialkot exporter.
  • ✓Direct dealing — every inquiry goes straight to Gold Horizon on WhatsApp.
  • ✓Built for export buyers — distributors, wholesalers, clinics, salons and tack suppliers.
